398.t: Refer to the exhibit. A network associate has configured OSPF with the following command. After completing the configuration, the associate discovers that not all the interfaces are participating in OSPF. Which three of the interfaces shown in the exhibit will participate in OSPF according to this configuration statement? (Choose three.)

o.A:
These commands need to be added to the configuration:
C-router(config)# router eigrp 123
C-router(config-router)# network 172.19.0.0
o.B:
These commands need to be added to the configuration:
C-router(config)# router ospf 1
C-router(config-router)# network 172.19.0.0 0.0.3.255 area 0
o.C:
These commands need to be added to the configuration:
C-router(config)# router rip
C-router(config-router)# network 172.19.0.0
o.D: No further routing configuration is required.
